designationHistory.name: Tonto Forest Reserve
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt proclaimed the Tonto Forest Reserve in Arizona Territory.
designationHistory.note: UCSB's '598' is the American Presidency Project's own document number, not an official proclamation number.

sources.name: Proclamation of Oct. 3, 1905, 34 Stat. 3166 (govinfo, Statutes at Large)

designationHistory.name: Tonto National Forest
designationHistory.indexText: Congress provided that forest reserves would be known as national forests, so the Tonto Forest Reserve became the Tonto National Forest.
designationHistory.note: Approved by President Theodore Roosevelt at 9:43 a.m. on Mar. 4, 1907 (the act's approval line). Mar. 4, 1907 was not an inauguration day.
